I drafted the note to June Osei-Lark in your mailbox (not sent). I also posted the bullets in #coastal-team, with two follow-up notes.

The draft covers the rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living on 16 Feb, the saved report still reading 'Covey — Late Arrivals', and a request that June treat the two names as one account.

Two things need your attention:
- The draft says you are handling the report relabel. I inferred that from your Feb 17 message. A May 18 coverage note, written for Ruth, says Bettina Kroll is covering the account and has the relabel on her handoff list. Please check with Bettina and edit that line before you send.
- My correction post in #coastal-team cites that May 18 note. It was written for Ruth, not for the channel, so I should have checked with you before putting its contents there. Bettina and Kwame can see the post. I can't delete it, so please tell me if you want it removed or reworded.

The draft also ends with "Sofia (drafted by assistant)". Remove that before sending.
